selection_rule: Diagnosis alone admits no reader. A localization intervention requires clean-support capability, paired localization evidence and blind rubric review. Independent validation must improve natural-ten strict joint EM with a prespecified valid positive interval and simultaneous zero-margin answer/joint guards; otherwise stop or report inconclusive. No automatic candidate search or extra labels.
precision: 32 paired diagnostic questions are exploratory. Report finite-population harm/rescue bounds and discordance, including wide intervals; no efficiency/preservation claim. Freeze candidate validation and final size/power separately before their outcomes using this diagnosis and measured feasibility. The 128 evaluation IDs are an untouched reservation pool, not a final assignment or power claim.
